# ASTM Store

> The ASTM Store is the official marketplace for ASTM International voluntary consensus standards, testing methods, and technical publications across industries including materials, manufacturing, chemicals, construction, and environmental assessment.

ASTM International develops and publishes thousands of technical standards used globally for testing, materials specification, and quality assurance. The store provides access to standards catalogs, training programs, and resources for standards development participation. Key focus areas include additive manufacturing (3D printing), industrial chemicals, construction materials, environmental assessment, and healthcare informatics systems.

## Key Topics

- ASTM International
- ISO/ASTM standards
- Additive manufacturing standards
- Testing methods
- Chemical properties
- Powder bed fusion
- Aerospace applications
- Environmental assessment
- Risk management
- Laboratory standards
- Concrete and cement standards
- Thermal insulation
- Computerized systems
- Sustainability standards
- Standards catalog

## Standards by Industry

- [Additive Manufacturing Standards](https://store.astm.org/additive-manufacturing-standards): ASTM/ISO additive manufacturing standards for aerospace, medical, and powder bed fusion applications including metal 3D printing
- [Industrial Chemical Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/industrial-chemical-standards.html): ASTM industrial chemical standards for testing acids, alcohols, glycols, and automotive chemicals
- [Cement Standards and Concrete Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/cement-standards-and-concrete-standards.html): ASTM cement and concrete standards for construction materials testing and aggregates
- [Environmental Assessment Standards and Risk Management Standards](https://store.astm.org/environmental-assessment-standards-and-risk-management-standards): ASTM environmental assessment and risk management standards for coal combustion products and waste
- [Catalyst Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/catalyst-standards.html): ASTM catalyst standards for FCC and chemical analysis testing methods
- [Atmospheric Analysis Standards](https://store.astm.org/atmospheric-analysis-standards): ASTM atmospheric analysis and air quality standards for emission testing and monitoring
- [Sustainability Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/sustainability-standards.html): ASTM sustainability and green building standards for construction and environmental impact
- [Thermal Insulation Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/thermal-insulation-standards.html): ASTM thermal insulation standards for heat transfer materials and testing methods
- [Computerized System Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/computerized-system-standards.html): ASTM computerized system and healthcare informatics standards including EHR specifications
- [Business Copy Product Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/business-copy-product-standards.html): ASTM business copy standards for printing products, toners, inks, and cartridges
